title: Suppress motion-gate alerts when diff bbox covers most of frame (global-change detection)
author: jill (operator-directed 2026-09-20, post d54d3b29-... alert on OUTSIDE_BACK_SOLAR)
plan_section: V2-063. Sibling to V2-062 (night headlight FP suppression). Same root-cause family — false-positive Telegram alerts caused by infra/gate.py YOLO classifier clearing non-subjects inside over-large diff crops — but different mechanism: V2-062 handles suntime/distance, V2-063 handles global-change (IR exposure rebalance, grass in wind, rain on lens, lightning, moth on dome).
trigger: Operator 2026-09-20 21:30 EDT verbatim: 'OK, you need to look at these alerts. Basically the entire image is moving for some reason. Maybe it's lightning or something. But when the crap is the entire freaking frame, it shouldn't be alerting on anything.' Alert d54d3b29-6db7-4c2d-a66b-bfe104600480 on OUTSIDE_BACK_SOLAR at 2026-09-20 20:56:42 EDT: YOLO cleared 'car 0.59', Vision VM1+VM2 confirmed 'vehicle/SUV definite', but the scene was a stationary dark SUV with headlights on, parked in the same spot for months. diff bbox = (0, 0, 2304, 864) and (0, 0, 2304, 1120) = 67% and 86% of the 2304x1296 frame. pairwise_diff.png vision-confirmed: noise spread across the whole frame (IR exposure rebalance / grass in wind / rain on lens), no localized subject.
background: infra/gate.py:run() currently checks changed-pixel counts (count_a, count_b in lines 968-980) against a low 'no_server_motion' threshold and falls through to the YOLO crop pass. It does NOT check the diff-bbox area as a fraction of the frame area — when the diff bbox covers most of the frame, the changed pixels are global-change noise, not a moving subject. YOLO inside such a large region clears whatever happens to be in the frame (often a stationary background vehicle like the truck row on OUTSIDE_BACK_SOLAR) and produces a high-confidence misclassification. Calibration against 24h of 2026-09-20 traffic: 1768 alerts with logged diff bboxes, 6 proceeded at bbox > 60% area (all 6 = the false positives we want to drop), 0 proceeded at 30-60%, 6 proceeded at 0-30% (legitimate). Threshold = 60% catches all 6 known FPs while losing zero legitimate alerts. Prior precedent b1d400da-... at 20:25:54 EDT (also OUTSIDE_BACK_SOLAR) had bbox 57% and proceeded — that one WAS already caught by the parallel VM1=unsure fix (commit 13301f4), but the gate-layer suppression is the more general cure and would have caught it too. AGENTS.md anti-pattern rule 'Before proposing a new X knob, grep for existing knobs that already do X' — verified no existing global-change / coverage-pct / wide-motion knob exists in infra/. The new env var FARMSURV_GLOBAL_CHANGE_MAX_PCT follows the established FARMSURV_* convention.

design_principles: Solution A: gate-layer suppression on diff-bbox coverage. Insert in infra/gate.py:run() between the existing 'no_server_motion' check (line ~1047-1063) and the crop step (line ~1065). Returns GateVerdict(classification='none', reason='global_change', ...).

Single env-var knob FARMSURV_GLOBAL_CHANGE_MAX_PCT, default 60 (calibrated). 0 disables. Negative disables. Garbage string falls back to 60 (matches AGENTS.md 'Garbage string falls back to default' convention via the _read_global_change_max_pct helper).
Suppress if MAX(pct_a, pct_b) > threshold (one big diff is enough; both are usually correlated in IR exposure reflash but be robust to either).
Threshold check uses the post-10%-padded, mult-32-rounded bbox that infra/gate.py already computes — NOT the raw changed-pixel mask. Reuse crop_bbox_a / crop_bbox_b (lines 1035-1036).
Minimal surface change. Three files: infra/gate.py, .env.example, tests/test_gate_global_change_suppress.py.
Single commit per story. Commit messages start with 'US-063x:' (US-063a for code, US-063b for tests, US-063c for docs).
